description: A chain ending in `else` whose first branch does not mount the declaration stays legal and renders a finite tree (#2139 review MED-2, the legal side).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-component-self-mount-error ("Guarded recursion (under `if=` / `<match>`, a new instance each level) stays legal."); PA reading pa-ruled:S483-every-path-mounts
rationale: §66.6.2 rule 2 (S483 r1): a nested use that some path does not mount is guarded recursion.
